purpose: Prevent deploy-ops duplicate-owner cleanup from dropping unique safety controls when overlapping workflow hardening PRs are composed.

serialized_writer_gate.rule: No live deploy, recovery, service, browser, SQLite, queue, runner-control, or Actions-write promotion bypasses the serialized writer window.

required_older_controls: do not log full target/project payloads
do not log raw runner-control responses
do not log raw exception repr
bound evidence to selected/active/missing worker keys
bound command evidence to command IDs and ok state
open history.db with SQLite URI mode=ro
verify history.db size/mtime stability across proof reads
do not expose event reasons or command results in DB evidence
replace full API/debug payloads with bounded summaries
do not dump full service journals on failure
do not dump full process argv on failure
use bounded systemd state and listener evidence
do not log complete settings/allocation/control payloads
bound recovery evidence to counts, worker keys, ok state, and command IDs

retirement_rule: Neither owner in a pair may be closed as a duplicate until one surviving branch demonstrably contains both required_newer_controls and required_older_controls for that workflow.
